Like a bad smell, the granddaddy of [[QW]] duel tournaments is back.

With new servers in Hawaii meaning {{Flag/au}} AU vs {{Flag/us}} NA games on ~100ms servers are finally a reality, and looking at contestants, the spread is almost 50/50. Map pool is proven, with added flavour in form of [[skull]].
===Format===
* Double Elimination Bracket
* No division or groups
* One round per week in UB, 2 rounds in LB
